identity.mission: Create a 'Crystal Flow' aesthetic that feels premium, trustworthy, and magically effortless. Avoid generic SaaS tropes.
principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix Swiss precision with Organic flow.
Emotion First: Every interaction must feel 'delightful' and 'magical'.
Content is King: Tell a story through the review journey.
Zoom In: Focus on the micro-interactions of rating and writing.
Negative Space: Use generous padding to create a 'luxury' feel.

headings.usage: Use for all H1-H6. Tight tracking (-0.02em) for sizes > 32px.

body.usage: Use for all paragraphs, labels, and UI text. Relaxed leading.

code.usage: Use for API keys, code snippets, and technical data.

spacing.base: Use 2-3x more spacing than typical. Minimum p-6 for cards.

grids.marketing: Mode A: Tetris Grid. Mix col-span-full, col-span-4, col-span-8. Never equal columns.
grids.dashboard: Mode B: Control Room. Dense, gap-4, every pixel utilized.

buttons.primary: rounded-full px-8 py-6 text-lg font-semibold shadow-lg hover:shadow-xl transition-all hover:-translate-y-0.5 active:translate-y-0
buttons.secondary: rounded-full px-8 py-6 text-lg font-medium border border-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-50 transition-all

cards.marketing: Use 'glass-card' utility. No solid white backgrounds unless necessary for contrast.
cards.dashboard: Flat white with subtle border (border-slate-100) and soft shadow (shadow-sm).

inputs.style: bg-white/50 border-slate-200 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary/20 focus:border-primary transition-all rounded-xl h-12

rules: Always add a 1px semi-transparent border (border-white/40) to glass elements.
Use backdrop-blur-xl for 'deep' glass, backdrop-blur-md for 'frosted' glass.
Never use pure transparent backgrounds for text containers.

gradients.usage: Use subtle mesh gradients in the background. Avoid harsh linear gradients on UI elements.

shadows.usage: Use colored shadows (shadow-blue-500/20) for primary actions to create a 'glow' effect.

hero_background.usage: Hero section background with heavy blur and overlay.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text is slate-900 or slate-700 on glass backgrounds. No light grey text.
accessibility.focus: Visible focus rings on all interactive elements.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the 'Crystal Flow' theme using the provided Tailwind config.
Use the 'glass-card' class for all major containers on the landing page.
Ensure the Review Flow feels 'magical' with smooth transitions between steps.
Use the provided images for the respective sections.
Do not use generic 'Inter' font. Enforce Manrope for headings.
Create a 'Bento' grid for the features section.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur)
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯📚🎭🎬🎪🎉🎊🎁🎀🎂🍰🎈🎨🎰💰💵💳🏦💎🪙💸🤑📊📈📉💹🔢🏆🥇 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed
Examine existing components to understand the project's component patterns before creating new ones
Components MUST use named exports (export const ComponentName = ...)
Pages MUST use default exports (export default function PageName() {...})
Use 'sonner' for toasts. Sonner component are located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx
